name: animation
description: A code-drawn animation: every frame is a pure function of time, rendered in headless Chrome.

scripts.review: npm run probe && npm run check && npm run video && npm run metrics && npm run sheet
scripts.smoke: npm test && node tools/render.mjs --page=index.html --stills=0 --out=out/smoke && node tools/render.mjs --page=index.html --sheet=all --out=out/smoke/sheet.png && node tools/render.mjs --page=index.html --video --to=2 --workers=2 --out=out/smoke/smoke.mp4 && node tools/metrics.mjs --video=out/smoke/smoke.mp4 && npm run probe && npm run check
